observation_summary: The compiler throws a java.lang.StackOverflowError when processing JavaScript code with deeply nested binary operations.
reasoning_summary: The stack trace shows a deep recursion between CodeGenerator.add and CodeGenerator.addExpr. This occurs when processing deeply nested binary operator nodes (like a long chain of additions). The code in CodeGenerator.add recursively calls addExpr, which in turn calls add, without any iterative mechanism to handle deep AST structures. When the AST depth exceeds the JVM stack limit, a StackOverflowError is thrown.
